hypotheses.name: Multiseed bifiltration robustness and utility coupling
hypotheses.method: Expanded H47 to 3 seeds (42/43/44) across immune/lung/external_lung, source/target disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}; computed distance x support cycle-rank scores vs distance-only baseline with distance-stratified support-shuffle nulls, then evaluated utility coupling to iter_0016 diffusion incremental deltas with layer-order placebo permutations.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.00599; positive rows 69/72; p<0.05 rows 48/72; domain-split Fisher significant 6/6; utility coupling positive in 1/3 domains and layer-placebo significant 0/3
hypotheses.next_action: Keep the bifiltration branch active but reframe utility linkage with an explicit held-out utility target and split-specific utility models before promotion.

hypotheses.name: Directed and signed topology pilot
hypotheses.method: Built directed/signed kNN topology features from support-direction margins (DoRothEA/OmniPath/STRING/GO) on seed42 across 3 domains, both disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}; compared AUROC against distance-only cycle baseline with node-relabel degree-orientation null and sign-shuffle null.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.01585; positive rows 11/12; p_degree<0.05 rows 7/12; p_sign<0.05 rows 8/12; domain-split Fisher significant 6/6
hypotheses.next_action: Promote to multiseed replication and tighten the directed null family with degree-preserving edge swaps plus split-holdout calibration.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model expanded motif fingerprint with module collapse
hypotheses.method: Computed scGPT vs Geneformer top-k overlap (k={100,200,400}, layers {7,11}) with expanded motif panel {FFL, bifan, feedback triad, feedforward chain, multi-input}; evaluated both gene-level and GO-module-collapsed variants under degree-preserving rewiring and module-membership shuffle nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: rows 36; degree-null p<0.05 rows 16/36; domain-variant Fisher significant 5/6 and at least one significant variant in 3/3 domains; module-shuffle p<0.05 rows 0/18
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this motif-overlap formulation unless redesigned around utility/topology transfer with non-degenerate null variance and module-shuffle robustness.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Cross-model motif overlap remains mixed after anti-sparsity redesign: degree-null enrichment is broad but module-shuffle control fails (0/18), and this branch already has repeated inconclusive history.
